-- PostgreSQL target dialect
WITH desk_totals AS (SELECT news_desk, COUNT(*) AS article_count FROM times_archive GROUP BY news_desk), ranked AS (SELECT news_desk, article_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY article_count DESC) AS desk_rank FROM desk_totals) SELECT * FROM ranked;

expected_result.description: Reserved expected columns for Desk share ranking.

reference_sql: WITH desk_totals AS (SELECT news_desk, COUNT(*) AS article_count FROM times_archive GROUP BY news_desk), ranked AS (SELECT news_desk, article_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY article_count DESC) AS desk_rank FROM desk_totals) SELECT * FROM ranked LIMIT 500;

title: Dense rank by length
prompt: Apply DENSE_RANK to articles by word count overall.
learning_objectives: Apply window to Times archive columns for this prompt.
Write a advanced-level PostgreSQL query for: dense rank by length.
sample_sql:
-- PostgreSQL target dialect
SELECT headline_main, word_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY word_count DESC) AS length_rank FROM times_archive;

expected_result.description: Reserved expected columns for Dense rank by length.

reference_sql: SELECT headline_main, word_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY word_count DESC) AS length_rank FROM times_archive LIMIT 500;
